subject: Add 8 GPUs mid-cycle — proration, VAT handling, invoice preference
messages:
From: Anna Lee <anna.lee@plymont.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: add 8 Dedicated GPUs mid-cycle — proration & VAT?

Hi Laura,

We need to add 8 GPUs to our Dedicated pool immediately (current plan: 32 GPUs). Our billing cycle for the account started 2026-05-01 and renews monthly on the 1st. Can you confirm how you handle mid-cycle capacity increases? Specifically:  

- A line-item proration for the remainder of the current billing period (we have 20 days left out of 30)
- Whether you issue a separate pro-rated invoice now or apply a credit to be netted on the next invoice (we prefer a single line item if possible)
- VAT handling: we are an EU-registered entity (Plymont Analytics, VAT ID: EU123456789). Will Redwood issue an invoice without VAT under reverse-charge, or do you need our full VAT docs?

We need the change active by EOD tomorrow if possible. Please include estimated charge so I can route for internal approval.

Thanks,
Anna
Billing Ops — Plymont Analytics

[external note: this is from our finance team; forwarding to billing@plymont.ai for records]

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@plymont.ai>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add 8 Dedicated GPUs mid-cycle — proration & VAT?

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and the VAT ID. Quick summary below and an estimate attached. 

Short answer: we can either (A) issue a separate pro-rated invoice now for the remaining days, or (B) apply a one-off charge on the next invoice and show the proration as a single consolidated line — we typically prefer separate immediate invoices for cash-flow but will consolidate on request.

Estimate (numbers illustrative):
- Current plan: 32 GPUs @ $200/GPU-month = $6,400/month
- Add 8 GPUs => incremental $1,600/month
- Proration: 20 days remaining / 30-day cycle = 0.6667 fraction
- Pro-rated charge = $1,600 * 0.6667 = $1,066.72 (rounded to $1,066.72)
- Recurring effective from 2026-06-01: +$1,600/mo on the 1st of each month

VAT: since you provided a valid EU VAT ID, we will treat the charge as reverse-charge (no VAT on Redwood invoice) for the EU entity. We will include both your VAT ID and our supplier VAT reference on the invoice. If you prefer us to issue a VAT-inclusive invoice to your non-EU entity, let me know.

I attached a quick estimate spreadsheet (estimate_plymont_addcap_20260511.xlsx). We can:
- Option 1 (default): generate an immediate pro-rated invoice for $1,066.72 + 0 VAT (reverse-charge), due in 7 days.
- Option 2 (per your preference): hold the proration and reflect it as a single line on the next monthly invoice (2026-06-01), with the same tax treatment.

Would you like us to proceed with Option 1? If yes, I will loop in Finance to create the invoice and send payment instructions.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

-----
Attachment: estimate_plymont_addcap_20260511.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3kb)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-11T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Plymont capacity top-up — invoice vs credit?

Priyom / Monica — forwarding Anna's request. Customer prefers a single invoice if we can consolidate the proration with the next renewal. They provided a VAT ID and want reverse-charge treatment.

Quick questions for Finance:  
- Is it ok from an accounting/AR perspective to hold the $1,066.72 proration and post it as a one-off on the 2026-06-01 invoice rather than issuing a separate invoice now? Customer preference is to avoid multiple payments for the same period.
- If we hold it, do we need to create a memo invoice now (non-payable) for internal audit, or is booking the deferred revenue on 6/1 acceptable?
- We also need to confirm the invoice header will include the supplied VAT ID and the reverse-charge note.

Suggested next steps: if finance agrees, I will tell the customer we will consolidate and send a single invoice on 2026-06-01 with the pro-rated line. If finance prefers issuing now, we'll send an immediate payable invoice (7-day term).

Thanks — Laura

> On May 11, 2026, at 09:12, Anna Lee <anna.lee@plymont.ai> wrote:
> > We need to add 8 GPUs... (message quoted)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@plymont.ai>, Plymont Analytics Billing <billing@plymont.ai>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-13T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add 8 Dedicated GPUs mid-cycle — proration & VAT?

Hi Anna — thanks for your patience. Finance confirmed we can accommodate your request to consolidate the proration onto the next invoice. Summary of final plan below: 

1) Change schedule
- Capacity change applied: +8 GPUs added 2026-05-13 (active now).
- Recurring billing for the extra 8 GPUs will begin 2026-06-01 at $1,600/month.

2) Proration and invoicing
- Prorated charge for 20/30 days = $1,066.72.
- We will NOT issue a separate payable invoice now. Instead we will post a one-line proration on the 2026-06-01 invoice (single consolidated invoice) as requested.
- Invoice will include: the proration line (USD), the recurring line for June onward, and a note indicating the service activation date.

3) VAT/tax treatment
- You provided VAT ID EU123456789. We will apply reverse-charge and leave VAT at 0% on the Redwood invoice. Invoice will show your VAT ID and reference our supplier VAT number. Please confirm the VAT ID exactly as you want it printed.

4) Payment terms
- Consolidated invoice will be issued on 2026-06-01 with Net 14 terms. If you need Net 30 for this account, confirm and we can adjust.

5) Next steps/attachments
- I've attached the final invoice (invoice_PLY-20260513_v2.pdf) for your records — though it's marked DRAFT pending issuance on 2026-06-01 per the agreed consolidation.
- Payment link (for immediate settlement if you decide not to consolidate): https://pay.stripe.com/invoice/INV_bQ7k9Zx

If everything looks good, reply with a quick confirmation of the VAT ID and your preferred payment terms. We'll follow up with the final posted invoice on 6/1.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
